Tricked you, it's not a patch at all.

3 icon files (binary/no patching) and atoms.dm updated; I'm at work right
now so I can't create a patch out of atoms.dm, sorry. Shouldn't be any
conflicts with previous versions though (based off of Kurpers revision

And no beer doesn't currently do something it's just fun to toss people a cold one.

uploaded even though your icons are terrible for right and left hand

Icon Update (swapped left and right hands and rotated the labels so they face OUT

but I am not an artist so screw you I am the bringer of beer what have you done ever

But wait! There's more.

Here's a mega-ultra beer patch.

3 new icon files (now with broken bottles), and a new file
/code/game/item/weapon/beer.dm

plus updated .dme to include the new file.

This allows the beer to 'attack' or 'help' people, or yourself, in several different
states. It's pretty awesome.

Some probability percentages might have to be tweaked according to the number of
bottles on the station. To prevent beer from becoming an uberweapon the bottles have
a chance of breaking/disintegrating upon use.
